mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 75 degrees with overcast skies over the Military Ridge State Trail and an air quality index of 53. The Waning Gibbous moon is out, and though the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight's low will be 61 degrees with rain in the forecast.

In city news, a section of Highway M near the future Aldi location is scheduled for road work from October 6 through October 9, so follow the detours. Also, remember that early voting for the November 3 election is approaching, and you can visit City Hall or the MyVote website to prepare.

There is plenty to do in our community, including Hop Haus Trivia and Lake Lou-ee Trivia happening today. Tomorrow, be sure to check out live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market.
In a weekly police report, officers noted that on September 21, a two-vehicle crash with injuries occurred, resulting in a citation for a driver operating too fast for conditions.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup, and since Culver's is open until 10 PM, there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
